detail: R-json-readers-outside-ai-state-do-not-cat-46a2: JSON readers outside .ai/state/ do not catch RecursionError (inventory of T-2026-10-31-1423)

data.title: JSON readers outside .ai/state/ do not catch RecursionError (inventory of T-2026-10-31-1423)
data.label: RISK
data.what: Inventory of every json.load/json.loads in state.py: the .ai/state/ readers (session.json 245, state.json 385, consent.jsonl 2558 and 2872, decision.json 2934) are fixed in T-2026-10-31-1423; these read files outside .ai/state/ and catch ValueError but not RecursionError: read_events (.ai/reports/<id>/events.jsonl, 334), sealed_task_ids (.ai/memory/*.jsonl, 468), read_quota (<home>/state/runtime-gate.json, 540, any Exception?), read_json_object (~/.claude.json, auth.json, drift-ack.json, 662), detect_codex JWT payload (715), --data (1149), ask --batch file (1567), --plan-file (3439). A line or file nested ~100000 deep tracebacks instead of the documented skip/die. The hooks' own readers (hooks/context-guard.py, hooks/dialog-gate.py, hooks/guard/dialog.py:228,402) were not audited.
data.likelihood: needs a hand-built file nested past the C stack limit
data.fix: add RecursionError to each except tuple (or read through json_loads_capped) with one deep case per reader; audit the hooks the same way

detail: R-reject-with-an-unreadable-decision-json-5580: reject with an unreadable decision.json records the rejection, then exits 1

data.title: reject with an unreadable decision.json records the rejection, then exits 1
data.label: KNOWN FACT
data.what: With the dialog on and decision.json malformed or too deep, reject needs no pick, so rejected_at is written before close_gate/retire_approvals die rc 1 'decision.json is unreadable'. Same for '{not json' and '[' * 200000; found by the s1 implementer of T-2026-10-31-1423, left unchanged (production behaviour).
data.fix: decide whether reject should read decisions before writing the rejection, or tolerate an unreadable file after it
